about.title: FUNCTIONAL ANALYST & JAVA DEVELOPER
about.description: Functional Analyst based in Brussels, Belgium, with 4+ years bridging business needs and technical delivery across enterprise and SaaS environments. I gather, analyse and document business requirements, model processes with UML & BPMN, write functional specifications and API documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI), and manage stakeholders — embedded with hands-on Java and Spring Boot development for close, clear collaboration with IT teams. Delivered functional analysis at enterprise scale across the Finance, Fitness, HR and logistics sectors (including Leejam Sports — 200+ locations, 100,000+ members). MBA in IT Management (2025). Trilingual — Arabic (native), English & French (B2), Dutch (A2, improving). Available immediately. Before IT, an international professional Muay Thai & Kickboxing champion.

details.title: Enterprise Requirements & Functional Analysis
details.description:
Led the functional analysis of an enterprise platform end-to-end: elicited and documented business requirements, ran AS-IS / TO-BE process modelling, and produced functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria consumed by the development and QA teams.

Facilitated stakeholder sessions from operations to management, defined 20+ secured REST endpoints as integration contracts (documented in Swagger/OpenAPI), and validated the delivered Spring Boot / Angular solution against the documented requirements.

details.title: Swagger API Documentation & Specification
details.description:
Design-first API specification project: defined the integration contracts between systems and documented every endpoint with Swagger / OpenAPI 3 before implementation. Produced the functional deliverables that drive delivery — user stories, acceptance criteria, request/response schemas, error contracts and a versioning strategy.

Facilitated the specification with stakeholders and translated business rules into precise, testable API definitions, then validated the running FastAPI implementation against the documented contract. Demonstrates direct experience specifying integration contracts and bridging business needs with engineering.

details.title: Business Process Modelling — BPMN & UML
details.description:
Modelled the business workflows of a sports management domain before implementation: mapped AS-IS processes, designed optimised TO-BE flows, and produced BPMN process diagrams and UML models that aligned business owners with the engineering team.

Defined the data model, CRUD operations and validation rules as functional requirements, then supported the build of the REST API and SPA against those specifications.

details.title: UAT & Functional Testing Coordination
details.description:
Coordinated functional testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business users: authored test cases from the acceptance criteria, validated system behaviour against requirements, tracked and triaged defects, and ran reconciliation checks on the data.

Bridged business stakeholders and the development team through the test cycle, signed off features against functional specifications, and kept a clear defect-to-requirement traceability throughout.

details.title: System Integration Contracts & Specifications
details.description:
Specified the integration contracts between systems: analysed the data exchanged, defined request/response schemas, error handling and versioning, and documented each contract in OpenAPI so producer and consumer teams could build in parallel.

Facilitated alignment sessions between the teams, maintained the specifications as the single source of truth, and validated that the delivered integrations matched the agreed contracts.

details.title: Data & Reporting Analysis — KPI Definitions
details.description:
Translated finance and operations reporting needs into functional specifications: defined KPIs, report layouts and the underlying data model for financial and operational dashboards (in the style of the IBM Cognos work at Leejam).

Documented billing, payment-status and reconciliation logic, specified the data flows behind each metric, and coordinated validation of the reports against the business rules with the stakeholders.

allExperience.designation: Functional Analyst & Java Developer — Logistics SaaS
allExperience.companyDescription: Self-employed, delivering an end-to-end SaaS platform for a Belgian logistics company — combining functional analysis and development. Mapped existing paper-based processes (AS-IS), defined optimised digital workflows (TO-BE) and documented functional requirements. Translated operational pain points — manual route planning, no dispatcher visibility, paper delivery confirmation — into concrete functional and technical specifications. Defined API specifications (Swagger/OpenAPI), user stories and acceptance criteria per module, and facilitated sessions with dispatchers and operations managers. Delivered the platform with end-to-end (E2E) testing across backend, web dashboard and mobile app. Outcome: ~40% reduction in route-planning time and full digitalisation of paper-based logistics workflows.
